sufficient_sets.text: Saturn is the sixth planet from the Sun, and is the second largest planet in the Solar System, after Jupiter.
Saturn ( ) was a god in ancient Roman religion, and a character in Roman mythology.
He was described as a god of time, generation, dissolution, abundance, wealth, agriculture, periodic renewal and liberation.
